data.body:
CONTEXT from operator ruling 2026-08-11: Resend stays on the FREE tier — no upgrade. That makes the 100/day send cap a hard constraint, not a cushion, and raises the stakes on this audit.

Two things worth asserting rather than assuming when this ticket runs: (1) the 'exactly two always_live write sites' invariant still holds across the whole tree — it was verified by count at MRQ-12's merge and counts drift; (2) bulk decision mail genuinely lands in the outbox rather than the wire. A rejection wave to ~900 submitters would exceed the daily cap roughly nine times over, and the failure mode during judging is either spamming real people or silently sending nothing.

Full context in sequence/OPERATOR-PRECONDITIONS.md section 4.
